objective: Only change mean-one per-row weights to N/(8*m_c), using sampled FIT class counts; no resampling or second class-weight multiplier
controls: Same ordered fitting rows, train-fitted scaler, joint feature mask and audit population; frozen sqrt-population trees must reproduce historical fit and audit prediction hashes
budget: Three fresh fixed-budget fits, 2400 trees per execution; all models frozen before audit; full independent replay before publication
screen: At every seed, audit macro-F1 and each rare-class F1 must exceed the sqrt-population tree, with benign false-alert rate no higher; descriptive continuation screen only, never deployment authorization
diagnosis: Keep natural-prevalence audit metrics; report all eight class precision/recall/F1, fit/audit gaps at a shared full-FIT prior and paired correctness counts; never call higher recall alone a success
